Hi team,

Attached is the recommended pay-mix for Sarah Liu (Data Platform Engineer, Level: L4). We built this off the standard L4 band and the candidate's counter. Key callouts in the attached spreadsheet:
- Base: $165,000 (aligns to midpoint + 5% for market)
- Target bonus: 10% (pro-rated first year to 7.5% given start date)
- RSU grant: $90,000 over 4 years (25% cliff year 1, then quarterly vest)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (gross, paid in two installments)
- Start date: target Oct 3 (affects proration)

Things I flagged for approval:
1) Approve the bumped base vs. standard midpoint? We recommended +5% to close.
2) Approve sign-on ($15k) vs. $10k standard for L4 — justification attached.

Marissa / Karthik — I ran a quick comparison and made a couple of edits to the attached spreadsheet (see comp-table-20270906.xlsx, sheet 'compare'). Summary below so we can close today: 

Candidate: Sarah Liu (L4) — target start Oct 3, remote (SF payroll)
Proposed (Julie): Base $165k / Bonus 10% TEB / RSU $90k 4yr / Sign-on $15k
Alternative A (band-aligned): Base $158k / Bonus 10% TEB / RSU $95k 4yr / Sign-on $10k
Alternative B (higher base, lower RSU): Base $168k / Bonus 10% TEB / RSU $80k 4yr / Sign-on $10k

My read: Total cash + equity T4 (year 1 equivalized)
- Proposed: $165k + sign-on + ~22.5k equivalent equity = ~$202k first-year cash/equiv
- Alt A: ~$197k
- Alt B: ~$200k

Recommendations (asking for single-line approvals so recruiting can send):
1) Approve Alternative B (Base $168k / RSU $80k / Sign-on $10k). Rationale: keeps 4-year TCO close to market while limiting sign-on and nudging equity into later vesting for retention.
2) Approve 7.5% proration on first-year bonus (start Oct 3).
3) Finalize offer language around vesting (25% cliff then quarterly) and acceleration only per standard policy.

If approved, I will ask Julie to issue the offer package today. If you prefer Proposed (Julie) we should also confirm headcount budget impact with finance — I flagged the delta in the spreadsheet.
